title: new-hires
text:
new-hires

Eli Navarro: hey everyone — first day at Redwood! super excited to be on infra/SRE. i rollerblade to work sometimes and i'm always down for a casual evening skate or a rooftop hang. also a big sci-fi fan — thinking of starting a tiny bookswap. anyone interested? 🛼📚
Maya Chen: welcome Eli!! :tada: rooftop + bookswap sounds delightful. when were you thinking?
Arjun Patel: welcome!! if folks want a quick beginner-friendly loop, there's a flat 3-mile route from the office to the pier. friday evening works for me — 6:15?
Zoe Martinez: count me in for bookswap. currently reading *The City in the Middle of the Night* — can bring it. also down to try rollerblading again after a decade 😂
Noah: i'll bring a couple of extra helmets and some spare wrist guards just in case. also shout if anyone prefers a quieter meetup (book-first, skating-second).
Eli Navarro: love it — book-first sounds great so folks can mingle. i'll bring a stack of my old paperbacks (sci-fi + a couple of thrillers). friday 6:15 rooftop then quick skate for whoever wants to join. i'll post a reminder tomorrow and pin a tiny list of books. thanks for the warm welcome! :heart:
